title: 第1112 章 母塔第1111 章 最后一道试炼
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: “大哥不在，我们接下来能干嘛？”
有人突然开口问。
大熊挠了挠头，望向空中几道传送门道：
“最低级的金仙境试炼也被其他人刷没怪了，剩下的无极境咱们还有能力搏一搏，至于启元境试炼想都别想。”
“无极境试炼也不好过，先前组队进去可没少死弟兄，最后那只首领实在是太猛了。”
“大哥不在还刷个屁啊，进去搞不好把小命丢了，别忘了我们这次已经收获满满了！”
众人全都默默点头，这话确实是说到心坎里了，现在还是不要冒险的好。
“剑哥，可有什么打算？”
大熊突然来到赵剑峰跟前，客气问。
赵剑峰想了想说道：“万妖塔试炼还有半个月结束，现在咱们哪个试炼都进不去，待在这里也是白待，你们要是没事就出去吧。”
“你呢？”
大熊听后又问。
赵剑峰盘膝而坐：“秦关是我们的队友，自然要等他出来一起离开。”
赵剑峰说完盘膝而坐，开始修炼起来。
看到赵剑峰修炼，刘裳他们也跟着坐下修炼起来。
“这话说的，秦关现在是我们的大哥，我们自然也要等他出来了。”
大熊挠了挠头，一屁股坐在了赵剑峰旁边：“那我也等，大哥不出来，我就不走！”
他身后那两千多人你看看我，我看看你，随后全都纷纷在附近找了位置坐下来。
两千多人就这么安安静静的坐在大殿里，没有人抱怨，没有人催促，全都决定等秦关出来。
塔奴坐在角落里，端着茶杯看着这一幕，轻声说了一句：“倒是少见。”
此刻，在大殿另一侧还有一群人静静的站在那里。
这群人是先前半路退出秦关队伍的那两千多人，其中还包括同名秦关和另外六个叛逃灵泽峰的弟子。
他们从秦关进入最后那道试炼开始就一直远远的看着。
金仙境试炼的妖兽早被他们刷空了，所有人都无怪可刷，之所以没离开，还是想留下来看看情况。
此刻看着两千多人全都静静的坐在那里修炼，他们心里五味杂陈。
这次万妖塔秘境，他们毛都没得到，大部分人就打了可怜的几百积分。
一想到先前主动退出秦关队伍，他们心里就一阵后悔。
“唉，走吧，这里已经没必要待了，有这时间不如出去做做宗门任务了。”
有人叹了口气，进入了离开万妖塔的传送门。
看到那人离开，众人深深看了眼最后那道试炼光门后，陆续跟着离开。
原本两千多人的大殿一侧，转眼变得空荡荡，同名秦关狄虎他们也全都离开了万妖塔。
另一边秘境中。
秦关看向自己所处的空间，满脸的疑惑。
眼前的场景和其它试炼秘境完全是两种不同的天地。
没有漆黑的密林，也没有翻涌的妖气，这里就好像是一片与外面世界一样的大陆。
“好强的禁制！”
神识扫向四方天地，秦关惊讶的发现，这方世界里笼罩着一道强大禁制，他的神识只能探查到百里。
此刻的自己正处在一片山林中。
小黑塔突然开口：“这里不对劲，怎么感受到了一股和我相似的气息？”
听到小黑塔的话，秦关皱眉：“相似的气息，什么意思？”
小黑塔：“就是塔的气息。”
“这里不是在万妖塔里面么，是万妖塔的气息吧？”
content_en:
"Brother is not here, what can we do next?"
Someone suddenly asked.
Big Bear scratched his head, looked at several portals in the sky and said:
"The lowest level of the Golden Fairy Realm Trial has been wiped out by others. We still have the ability to give the remaining Wuji Realm a try. As for the Qiyuan Realm Trial, don't even think about it."
"The trial of the Infinite Realm is not easy either. Many brothers died when we formed a team before. The leader in the end was just too powerful."
"What a waste of time if Brother isn't here. You might lose your life if you go in. Don't forget that we have already gained a lot this time!"
Everyone nodded silently, these words really came from the bottom of their hearts, it was better not to take risks now.
"Brother Jian, what are your plans?"
Daxiong suddenly came to Zhao Jianfeng and asked politely.
Zhao Jianfeng thought for a while and said: "The trial of the Ten Thousand Demons Tower is over in half a month. Now we can't enter any trial. It's useless to stay here. If you have nothing to do, go out."
"What about you?"
Big Bear asked again after hearing this.
Zhao Jianfeng sat cross-legged: "Qin Guan is our teammate, so naturally we have to wait for him to come out and leave together."
After Zhao Jianfeng finished speaking, he sat cross-legged and began to practice.
Seeing Zhao Jianfeng practicing, Liu Shang and the others also sat down and started practicing.
"That said, Qinguan is our eldest brother now, so naturally we have to wait for him to come out."
Daxiong scratched his head and sat down next to Zhao Jianfeng: "Then I'll wait too. I won't leave until big brother comes out!"
The more than two thousand people behind him looked at me and I looked at you, and then they all found places to sit nearby.
More than two thousand people sat quietly in the hall. No one complained or urged. They all decided to wait for Qin Guan to come out.
Tanu sat in the corner, holding a tea cup and watching this scene, and said softly: "It's rare."
At this moment, there was a group of people standing there quietly on the other side of the hall.
This group of people were the more than 2,000 people who had withdrawn from Qin Guan's team halfway before, including Qin Guan with the same name and six other disciples who had defected to Lingze Peak.
They have been watching from afar since Qinguan entered the final trial.
They had already wiped out all the monsters in the Golden Fairyland trial, and no one had any monsters to kill. The reason why they didn't leave was because they wanted to stay and see the situation.
At this moment, seeing more than two thousand people sitting there quietly cultivating, they felt mixed emotions.
This time, they didn't get any points in the Secret Realm of the Ten Thousand Demons Tower, and most of them only scored a few hundred points.
When they thought about voluntarily withdrawing from the Qinguan team, they felt regretful.
"Hey, let's go. There's no need to stay here anymore. It's better to go out and do sect tasks while we have this time."
Someone sighed and entered the portal leaving the Ten Thousand Demons Tower.
Seeing the man leaving, everyone took a deep look at the last trial light door and then left one after another.
One side of the hall, which originally had more than two thousand people, became empty in an instant, and Qin Guan Dihu and the others also left the Ten Thousand Demons Tower.
In the secret realm on the other side.
Qin Guan looked at the space he was in, with confusion on his face.
The scene in front of me is completely different from other secret trial realms.
There is no dark forest or surging demonic energy. This place seems to be a continent similar to the outside world.
"What a strong restriction!"
His spiritual consciousness swept across the world, and Qin Guan was surprised to find that there was a powerful restriction covering this world, and his spiritual consciousness could only detect a hundred miles away.
At this moment, I am in a mountain forest.
Xiao Heita suddenly said: "There's something wrong here. Why do you feel an aura similar to mine?"
Hearing Xiao Heita's words, Qin Guan frowned: "What do you mean by similar breath?"
Little Black Tower: "It's the breath of the tower."
"Isn't this inside the Ten Thousand Demons Tower? Is it the aura of the Ten Thousand Demons Tower?"
